changes: A pull request (a change up for review) sets a new release on network. It also adds a cluster-a queue with a taken name.
watch: terragucci plans fifteen estates in three waves. Cluster-a fails and its six apps are blocked. The fix plans as a cone, and an operator applies to app-01's estate beside the pipeline.
shows: Each resource keeps its own record, so a fix plans as a cone. Two applies to one estate both land, and neither waits.
